instruction: Apartment split conversion from init.ifc. Open C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc in Archicad. Use C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_plan.png and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_section.png as references while converting the shell into the required two-storey apartment split. The init file is a starting condition, not the final deliverable. Save an IFC4 export to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and export a tab-delimited room schedule to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.txt. Keep the shaped model envelope approximately within min 0.0, 0.0, -0.048 and max 14.0, 4.0, 6.6, with 0.5 m tolerance. The IFC must have unique GlobalId values, exactly two building storeys, exactly six IfcSpace rooms, at least eight walls, at least two slabs, at least one roof, and at least four doors. On the lower storey create 101-L APT-101-LIVING 20.0 m2, 101-K APT-101-KITCHEN 20.0 m2, and 101-B APT-101-BED 16.0 m2. On the upper storey create 201-L APT-201-LIVING 20.0 m2, 201-K APT-201-KITCHEN 20.0 m2, and 201-B APT-201-BED 16.0 m2. The schedule must use headers RoomNumber, RoomName, Area, list those rows in order, keep each area within +/-0.10 m2, and total between 111.0 and 113.0 m2. Equivalent Archicad or IFC export internals, object names, relationship structure, materials, and property sets may vary; the required result is the stated BIM model and deliverables, not a byte-for-byte copy of the teacher IFC. [Software] Launch ArchiCAD with `C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad` (adjust version/path).
